caption:
Three ways to disagree politely

I used to nod along to opinions I did not share. Then I started saying not my favorite.

A small, plain disagreement tends to land better than people expect, and it keeps the nodding from piling up.

For whoever disagrees kindly instead of nodding along.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table and a royal blue figure that says loved that movie. with happy eyes, in three labeled scenes. The nodder: a teal figure says yeah, totally. while narrowing its eyes and trembling. The takedown: a brown figure says that was awful. and the blue one looks down. The plain view: an ink-black figure leans in and says not my favorite., and ends with happy eyes. The text stays: three kinds of disagreeing. The last card: Choose friction.
